verify_reasons: Official NDOT ODV permit page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch this run; escort matrix, superload handling and validity were reconstructed from NDOT's published ODV summary and cross-referenced industry regulation guides, not read from the DOT manual directly — confirm with NDOT (800-552-2127).
Escort thresholds below are the Interstate/4-lane values; 2-lane thresholds are lower (pilot over 12') — confirm per route.
Overweight/superload fee is not codified as a flat number; NDOT bills additional coordination/engineering costs to the permittee case-by-case.

superload_thresholds.note: Nevada issues super-load permits case-by-case. Routine self-issuable ODV limits are about 17' wide and 16' high; loads beyond routine limits (including extraordinary weight/length) get individual NDOT route and structural review. No fixed superload gross number published.

width.note: 1 pilot over 14' wide on Interstate/4-lane (over 12' on 2-lane)
over 17' wide: 2 pilots and Nevada Highway Patrol may be required

length.note: 1 pilot over 110' overall; rear overhang over 25' also requires a pilot

single_trip.fee_formula: 5-day single-trip Over-Dimensional Vehicle (ODV) permit = $25. Overweight and superload moves may add engineering/coordination costs billed to the permittee; obtain the quote through NDOT's ODV permitting system.
single_trip.note: Single-trip ODV permit valid 5 days; annual multi-trip ODV permit $60.

annual.note: Annual multi-trip ODV permit $60 for qualifying repetitive moves.

movement_restrictions: Movement limited to one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset for oversize loads
Metropolitan-area weekday commute-hour and holiday restrictions may apply per permit
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 14'0", GVW 80,000 lbs; routine ODV permits reach ~101,000 lbs on 7 axles.
